```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
station = "KATL"
evaluated_at = "2026-07-29T20:00:00Z"
raw_input_path = ""
processed_input_path = ""
artifact_root = "."
```

```{python}
#| include: false
from pathlib import Path

from IPython.display import Markdown, display

from aviation_weather_support.reporting import (
    build_report_header,
    load_report_render_data,
    portable_source_path,
)

output_root = Path(artifact_root).resolve()
report_data = load_report_render_data(
    output_root,
    station=station,
    evaluated_at=evaluated_at,
    raw_input_path=raw_input_path,
    processed_input_path=processed_input_path,
)
observation = report_data.observation
assessment = report_data.assessment
category = assessment.flight_category
header = build_report_header(report_data)
raw_source_reference = report_data.raw_source_reference or portable_source_path(
    output_root, report_data.raw_source_path
)
processed_source_reference = (
    portable_source_path(output_root, report_data.processed_source_path)
    if report_data.processed_source_path is not None
    else "Not applicable (assessment generated from committed fixture)"
)
retrieval_time = (
    report_data.retrieved_at.isoformat()
    if report_data.retrieved_at is not None
    else "Not recorded for committed fixture"
)


def display_value(value):
    if value is None:
        return "Not reported"
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return ", ".join(str(item) for item in value) or "None reported"
    return str(value)


def observed_text(hazard):
    return "; ".join(
        f"{key.replace('_', ' ').title()}: {display_value(value)}"
        for key, value in hazard.observed_value.items()
    )
```

```{python}
heading = f"""
> **Airport / Station:** `{header.station}` \\
> **Observation time:** {header.observation_time} \\
> **Report generated from data evaluated:** {header.evaluated_at} \\
> **Report date:** {header.report_date} \\
> **Overall concern:** {header.overall_concern} \\
> **Official flight category:** {header.flight_category}
"""
display(Markdown(heading))
```

## Interpretation

```{python}
active = [
    hazard.label
    for hazard in assessment.hazards
    if hazard.concern_level.value in {"attention", "high_attention"}
]
detail = (
    " Active project-defined concerns: " + ", ".join(active) + "."
    if active
    else " No listed project hazard trigger is active."
)
interpretation = (
    f"The centralized assessment reports the official ceiling-and-visibility "
    f"weather category as **{category.category.value}** and the highest active "
    f"project-defined concern as **{assessment.overall_display_label}**."
    f"{detail} Data completeness is **{assessment.data_complete}**. "
    f"{assessment.disclaimer}"
)
display(Markdown(interpretation))
```

Official weather categories and project-defined concern levels are separate.
Neither result labels a flight safe or unsafe or grants aircraft-specific
operating approval.

## Project-defined hazard screening

```{python}
#| label: tbl-current-hazards
#| tbl-cap: "Observed evidence and centralized project-defined concern results"
lines = [
    "| Hazard | Observed | Concern | Confidence |",
    "| --- | --- | --- | --- |",
]
for hazard in assessment.hazards:
    lines.append(
        f"| {hazard.label} | {observed_text(hazard)} | "
        f"{hazard.display_label} | {hazard.data_confidence.value.title()} |"
    )
display(Markdown("\n".join(lines)))
```

```{python}
hazard_sections = []
for hazard in assessment.hazards:
    text = (
        f"### {hazard.label}\n\n"
        f"- **Result:** {hazard.display_label}\n"
        f"- **Trigger applied:** {hazard.trigger}\n"
        f"- **Operational context:** {hazard.operational_judgment}\n"
    )
    if hazard.confidence_note:
        text += f"- **Confidence note:** {hazard.confidence_note}\n"
    hazard_sections.append(text)
display(Markdown("\n\n---\n\n".join(hazard_sections)))
```

## Official flight category

```{python}
#| label: tbl-flight-category
#| tbl-cap: "Official ceiling-and-visibility weather category"
category_rows = [
    ("Category", category.category.value),
    ("Observed", "; ".join(
        f"{key.replace('_', ' ').title()}: {display_value(value)}"
        for key, value in category.observed_value.items()
    )),
    ("Category trigger", category.trigger),
    ("Data complete", str(category.data_complete)),
    ("Operational context", category.operational_judgment),
]
lines = ["| Field | Result |", "| --- | --- |"]
lines.extend(f"| {field} | {value} |" for field, value in category_rows)
display(Markdown("\n".join(lines)))
```

## Supporting data and provenance

The observation comes from saved data originally obtained from the
[Aviation Weather Center Data API](https://aviationweather.gov/data/api/).
Quarto rendering does not call the live API. The report validates its saved
response and consumes the complete result from the package's centralized
operational rules. It does not reproduce thresholds or concern aggregation.

```{python}
metadata = f"""
- **Raw source file:** `{raw_source_reference}`
- **Processed source file:** `{processed_source_reference}`
- **Station:** `{observation.icao_id}` ({observation.airport_name})
- **AWC observation time:** `{header.observation_time}`
- **AWC report time:** `{observation.report_time}`
- **Retrieval time:** `{retrieval_time}`
- **Assessment time:** `{header.evaluated_at}`
- **Report date:** `{header.report_date}`
"""
display(Markdown(metadata))
```

## Sources

```{python}
sources = {}
for source in category.source_basis:
    sources[(source.title, source.url)] = source
for hazard in assessment.hazards:
    for source in hazard.source_basis:
        sources[(source.title, source.url)] = source
source_lines = [
    f"- [{source.title}]({source.url}): {source.relevance}"
    for source in sources.values()
]
display(Markdown("\n".join(source_lines)))
```

## Rebuild

From an installed package with the report extra and Quarto available, rebuild
the committed offline fixture with:

```console
aviation-weather-support report --fixture KATL
```
